workflow.name: Smart Trade Alert Dispatcher for Slack & Telegram
workflow.description: Monitors AAPL stock using RSI and price data, generates AI market summaries, and routes alerts by priority to Telegram (HIGH) or Slack (LOW/MEDIUM).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: API key for OpenAI (GPT-5.1) to generate market summaries

OPENAI_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible API endpoint

MODEL.description: LLM model name to use for AI summary generation

TWELVEDATA_API_KEY.description: API key for TwelveData (mocked in this project)

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token (mocked in this project)

TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.description: Telegram chat ID for sending alerts (mocked)

SLACK_CHANNEL_ID.description: Slack channel ID for sending alerts (mocked)

GMAIL_RECIPIENT.description: Email address for error alert notifications (mocked)

workflow_steps.name: Fetch RSI Indicator
workflow_steps.description: Fetch RSI (14-period, 5min intervals) indicator data from TwelveData API for momentum analysis

workflow_steps.name: Fetch Price & Volume Data
workflow_steps.description: Fetch real-time price quote and volume metrics from TwelveData API

workflow_steps.name: Merge API Responses
workflow_steps.description: Merge RSI and price/volume API responses into a single data stream for signal processing
